notes.title: A Waitress Is on Her Way!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

Running a pizzeria is more than just baking – it’s about keeping your customers happy, managing the dining room, and handling the growing crowd. And when the place starts getting busy, you won’t be able to do it all alone. But don’t worry – help is on the way!

[b]Meet the Waitress![/b]

Today we’re sharing the first look at our in-progress waitress character. She’s still in development, but we’re excited to show you her early concept art and 3D design work. From outfit ideas to first animations – she’s getting closer to making her debut in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/2f44f22c67baed53690b9b6db39977fc577d5971.png[/img]

The waitress will be your right hand in the dining room – taking orders at the tables, serving pizzas, and making sure your guests leave with a smile. With her on board, you’ll be able to focus more on baking, upgrading your place, and growing your business.

[b]When Will She Join the Team?[/b]

At the start of the game, you’ll be the chef, the boss, and the manager all in one. But as your pizzeria grows and traffic picks up, you’ll unlock the option to hire staff – and that’s when the waitress comes in. You’ll choose when and how to bring her on board, depending on your strategy and needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/bcb99dae88aab79f42bda4c7cfa56c877fcc791a.png[/img]

Let us know what you think of her design on Discord – your feedback is always appreciated. And don’t forget to wishlist Pizza Slice on Steam to keep up with the latest updates!

notes.title: A Pizza full of Personality!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

Pizza Slice is heating up – and not just in the kitchen! In today’s devlog, we’re taking a closer look at the people walking the streets of our pizza-loving city. Yep, we’re talking about NPCs – and how we’re making sure each one is as unique as your favorite pizza topping combo.

[b]No Clones Here – Every NPC Looks Different![/b]

We didn’t want to populate the streets with cookie-cutter characters. That’s why we’ve built a randomization system that creates tons of unique NPCs. From hairstyles and clothing to accessories and color palettes – each citizen will have their own style. Some of them might even become local legends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/5a8fd1b48d1215a82f08e0eda91c208eca16d668.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/0c64f944691c251aa35a22fa82f88ac51dcd3bc4.png[/img]

[b]Their Taste Buds, Your Challenge[/b]

But it’s not just about how they look – our NPCs react to what you serve them! Depending on the ingredients and quality of your pizza, you’ll see a variety of reactions: smiles, surprise, and sometimes… awkward silence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/bac6785cb151cd5b2f5643904a302cdfd8be8db4.gif[/img]

We’ve already created several customer reactions and sample pizzas, some of which you can preview in this devlog. In the future, we plan to expand this even further with new customer types, preferences, and expressions to make every order more meaningful (and a bit unpredictable).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/a3bc31a156586aa81a9f77c0622ba6db3e6c5e2a.gif[/img]

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

Our team is currently focused on expanding the variety of pizzas, improving customer feedback, and fine-tuning NPC behavior. We want your pizzeria to feel alive – where every customer has a voice, and every slice tells a story.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/D8FUrZzTpD]Discord[/url] and let us know what kind of characters you’d love to see in-game! And if you haven’t already, make sure to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice/]Pizza Slice[/url] on Steam so you don’t miss the latest updates.

[h3]Until next time – and remember: every customer brings a new story to bake![/h3]

notes.title: Looking Back on 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

Time flies and we're not slowing down! It's been an incredibly exciting year for our team and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290][b]Pizza Slice[/b][/url] project - a year of change, challenge, and growth. We started our journey as [i]Pizza Simulator[/i], but as time went on the project underwent a huge transformation, both in the game itself and in its identity. The new name - [b]Pizza Slice[/b] - perfectly reflects what we want to offer: a slice (or rather a full portion) of the great fun of running your own pizzeria!

In this devlog, we recap the major changes and events of the year, but that's not all! We look behind the scenes, discuss where we're heading in the coming months, and let you know what's in store for players in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/a76f0c0ab656228ccad57001ad7368fb2b57a196.png[/img]
[h2]New name, new vision[/h2]
After a long absence from our side in the first half of the year (for which we apologize), we returned with a big change this November. A new name, a refreshed Steam page, and a different direction for the game. It was an extremely important moment for us but your response exceeded our expectations. Your embrace of the changes, positive comments, and feedback have given us even more motivation and reassurance that we are on the right track. 

With these changes, [b]Pizza Slice[/b] communicates what it is better – it's not just a game, but a full-fledged, humorous adventure that immerses the player in the world of running their own pizzeria. From competing with local restaurants to solving everyday problems and making tough business decisions, our vision has come full circle.

One of the highlights of this year was the announcement of the game's release. [b]Coming in 2025, Pizza Slice[/b] will challenge you to manage a pizzeria and bake the best pizza ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/977dfee2ac1c05539b1b01cf286fe6a2b9f15081.png[/img]
[h2]What was going on behind the scenes?[/h2]
Over the past few weeks, Pizza Slice has undergone a number of significant changes that will take the game to a whole new level!

First of all, we have improved the fluidity and visuals of the game. These improvements make the town, your pizzeria and of course the pizzas themselves look even more inviting!

We also didn't forget to make the game world more dynamic and alive. Improved NPC behavior makes the townspeople react more naturally, and interactions with them are more interesting and satisfying.
We also redesigned the dough kneading system to make it more intuitive and engaging.

But creating [b]Pizza Slice [/b]isn't just about coding and designing mechanics, it's also a lot of artistic work and creative brainstorming. From the initial sketches of the pizzeria to the design of the characters to the details that create the atmosphere of the game, a lot was going on behind the scenes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/1c20260ca1490fb4960c4c27976f578001576c64.png[/img]
[h2]A journey into the future[/h2]
A year of change and progress is behind us, but this is only the beginning of our pizza adventure! Now it's time to look ahead and tell you what we're working on and planning for the coming months. 

At the beginning of the year, we will be focusing on further refining the AI and behaviour of the NPCs. We want the interactions you encounter during gameplay to be not only realistic but also rewarding and engaging.

We are also working on increasing the number of ingredients available in the game – we plan to double their current number, which will give you even more opportunities to create unique pizzas and experiment in the kitchen! 

These changes are just part of what we are preparing for you, and the next few months will bring even more exciting updates.

notes.title: Pizza: Facts you never knew!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

Today we have something special to help you wait for the big news we will announce - a collection of interesting facts about pizza! You'll find out where this much-loved dish comes from and how its history relates to our game. But be warned - these are tasty facts that may whet your appetite. Are you ready? Here we go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/5f538516823882e1ff5ec885f3f667df577bfa28.png[/img]
[h2]#1[/h2]
Ancient Greeks ate pies with various toppings, but pizza as we know it today was born in Naples in the 18th century. Our game may be about Italian cuisine, but we run a restaurant in the heart of New York. A little Greek history, Italian flavor, and New York energy -  this is worldly!

[h2]#2[/h2]
In 1889, in honor of Queen Margherita, a pizza was created with ingredients representing the colors of the Italian flag: green basil, white mozzarella, and red tomatoes. It's a classic that shows that simplicity always defends itself, unlike pizza with pineapple...

[h2]#3[/h2]
Filipino Kevin Medina ate an entire pizza in 32.28 seconds! This is an official Guinness World Record. If you think you're fast at serving customers in our game, imagine what would happen if a Kevin like that came into your pizzeria! A word of advice: keep him away, because he might not only eat your pizza but also your business! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/bf37d0048c8e1f11dfe2987564dd40ba60d93c78.png[/img]
[h2]#4[/h2]
One of the most expensive pizzas in the world costs a fortune - and that's thanks to toppings like 24-carat gold, truffles, and caviar. Pizza Simulator may not sell pizzas at that price, but who knows, one day you might discover the secret recipe for a pizza worth a fortune!

[h2]#5[/h2]
Just when you think you've waited a long time for your pizza... Imagine if someone ordered a pizza from London and it arrived in Melbourne... in Australia... after 2 days! And it was still delicious! In Pizza Simulator, you won't have to worry about such delays, unless the order is delivered by your cousin Alfonso...

[h2]#6[/h2]
In 2001, Pizza Hut delivered a pizza to the International Space Station! Pizza in space? We're sticking to Earth for now, but who knows, maybe one day our pizzas will go into orbit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/8700330eda913e91d7ec85b5f64a064d72b9af53.png[/img]
That's all for today! As you can see, the world of pizza is full of surprises. [b]Pizza Simulator[/b] is a game that combines a passion for making pizzas with a lot of fun. Follow our devlogs and add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/][b]wishlist[/b][/url] on Steam, as we'll be revealing more about the next updates soon. [h1]Ciao, Pizza Managers![/h1]

For us, this is not only a time to work hard on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/][b]Pizza Simulator[/b][/url], but also a moment to immerse ourselves in the magical atmosphere of Christmas with you. Italy is a country where this period has a special meaning. Family gatherings, traditional dishes, and street markets, all contribute to this unique atmosphere that we want to bring closer to you. Let's enter an Italian home, where the smell of pizza mixes with the scent of the Christmas tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/8c10effa0eb6851f14436462dc1b39aca9633cbc.jpg[/img]
[h2]Currently in the oven[/h2]
In the latest phase of work on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/][b]Pizza Simulator[/b][/url], we are intensively developing various elements of the game, focusing on refining them and introducing new features. We are still working on advanced AI for customers to make them behave more organically. We are expanding the tutorial, creating a comprehensive guide to the game's mechanics, enhanced with animated 2D and 3D models. The next stages of development will focus on completing character models, such as the waiter and Alfonso's character. We also plan to integrate the progression system with other game mechanics, fine-tuning the character animation of the AI client and implementing the AI cousin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/566471edc5e66c7a5926a4b00567ee5f35812b94.jpg[/img]
[h2]Italian traditions[/h2]
Before closing in their homes for the two days of Christmas, Italians prepare for this moment with flair. It's a time to get together with loved ones, neighbors, and friends. In Italy, the festive season begins on 8 December. This is when the streets of the cities come alive and the creativity and good taste of the Italians are fully expressed in the beautiful decorations. 

Christmas trees ([i]albero di natale[/i]), Santa Claus ([i]babbo natale[/i]), baubles, garlands, lights, angels, reindeer, bows and stars - Italians move through a veritable fairytale landscape. There is no shortage of fantastic sights, such as the giant Christmas tree-shaped light display set up every year on the slopes of Mount Ingino, or the Christmas tree in Milan, decorated with Swarovski crystals.

The Italian tradition of nativity scenes is firmly established, and Christmas markets ([i]mercatini di natale[/i]) add magic from the north of the country to Rome itself. It is a time when the streets are filled with the aroma of traditional foods and the stalls are filled with original gifts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/805989691723840835f7d7bb7cd02501621792ca.jpg[/img]
At this special time of year, we would like to send you our warmest wishes. We wish you much joy, love, the warmth of the family, and always hot and tasty pizza! May the New Year bring you success and many happy moments.
